caveats: Merged NIFTY x India-VIX overlap sample n=2866, 2011-07-21..2023-04-05 (VIX vault ends 2023-04; MA200 min_obs=200 trailing, VIX expanding_percentile min_obs=252, both no-lookahead). Registered 4 cells are the trend(above/below 200dMA) x VIX-extreme-quintile(Q1,Q5) corners only; the full 2x5 quintile matrix is printed by the script for context but is not itself a registered cell. Dispersion = std of fwd 21d simple return within corner. belowMA_loVIX is thin (n=31, just above the stated MIN_CELL_N=30 floor) so its own stats are low-confidence descriptive; all other corners well-powered. No survivorship issue (index-level series only).
